quickref.status: 28 fan uploads (Jul 9-Oct 17, 2026) catalogued with titles, dates, run times and chapters. Builds: PT1 2.54.0, PT2 3.0.0 (inferred), PT3 3.0.2, PT4 3.0.5_2026.11.19_B1 (as it reads on screen; B and 8 look alike in that font), PT5 3.0.7_2026.11.19_b7. The second stamp line is a per-account number.
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Chapters name maps, modes and characters only, never weapons. Automatic thumbnails (now also at 1280x720 as maxres1-3) are not at fixed 25/50/75% points.
quickref.impact_end_result: No 2026 frame shows the Hazard Toy, Energy Overflow or Rake. Per-class chapter timestamps (B-1000, Botch, Astoria, Oliver) are listed for a watcher to check.

quickref.status: BBG 2.27 (May 29, 2017). Wiki stats edited 2026-09-18 (35-50 to 25-50 explosives, 5 to 4 damage) with no source, two days before PT4. Not seen in any 2026 frame.
quickref.look: Translucent bottle-green three-bladed fidget spinner (blades about #1F4D21, edges #42A731) with a concentric-ring hub (#1D2A20/#215825), about Botch's head wide (~0.5x Oliver). HUD icon: dark-green trefoil with a lime ring centre.
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Straight, fast thrown spinner: 1,100 u/s, 3 ammo, 1.5 s, 3.5 s reload (wiki). Seen skimming low along floors in 2018 and 2024 frames.
quickref.impact_end_result: Explodes on contact (25-50) and poisons in the radius, stacking across clouds (wiki). Dark-purple puff clouds where it landed plus a purple/green skull status icon overhead (2018 frame; cloud attribution inferred).

quickref.status: BBG 2.3 (image Sep 28, 2013). Wiki 'Charge Time 3' added 2026-09-20 05:17 UTC, before PT4, with no source. Not seen in 2026; the only 2026 B-1000 HUD reads 0/1 (probably the Bearail Gun).
quickref.look: Short wide forearm cylinder: white panels (#DED6CF) framed in orange (#A85E1A), a dark hex muzzle with a grey rim, a ring of cyan lights (#30BED3). Opens three white fins with cyan panels in play. About 0.5x Oliver long.
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Two uncharged shots (45) or one charged blast (140); while charging, particles converge on the barrel, and at full charge orbs of light appear at the tip (wiki). Short yellow-gold streaks and a yellow floor glow in a 2014 frame.
quickref.impact_end_result: No AoE (wiki). A yellow-white burst with spark rays on the target (2013 frame).

quickref.status: In BBG by Jan 2014. Held at 6/10 in a 2023 match (build 2.53.6). Wiki 'Rakes can be removed by explosives' added 2026-09-23 with no source. Not seen in 2026 frames.
quickref.look: Dark-grey riveted rectangular head (#43474A / #3F494B) with five flat turquoise teeth (#32E3B5 / #35E6B6) on a long dark-grey handle. The head is about the wielder's head width; the whole rake is about 0.8x Oliver.
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Placed on the ground; single use, stackable; can be triggered by shooting it or by reloading; 10 ammo, 1 s reload (wiki).
quickref.impact_end_result: Springs up on whoever steps on it for 110 damage; removed by explosives; can self-kill (wiki). The spring-up has never been observed.

quickref.status: Named on the 2026 Steam page [Canon]. In 2026 tutorials (70/70 at 2.54.0, 53/70 at 3.0.5) and a PT4 match (40/40 = 25 + Ammo+2), paired with the Bearzooka.
quickref.look: 2026 HUD icon: grey-green rifle with maroon-red panels (#683231-#873742), a thin silver barrel, and a white salt shaker (#CFDFDE-#ECF3F9) on a ribbed sleeve on top. Pale sage-grey in hand (#7C8E7A). About 0.6x Oliver.
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Automatic, damage 6, 0.15 s, 25 ammo, 3.0 s reload (wiki). 2026 frame: white-grey muzzle puff with white sparks. Tracer not distinguishable.
quickref.impact_end_result: A spiky yellow starburst (#F4E04B) with long rays on the struck enemy in the same 2026 frame (attribution inferred). No status effect.

quickref.status: BBR 1.3.1 (2012). It is the 25-round rifle in [LA]Huggable's final-playtest Oliver games and in droid BBG's PT4 videos (HUD icon match).
quickref.look: Silver-grey rifle, five barrel holes (three over two), a tilted canister with glowing red-orange slits on top, dark teal tip. Held at chest height.
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Automatic, damage 5, 0.15 s, 25 ammo (40 with Ammo+2), 2.0 s reload (wiki). Round magenta-pink muzzle bloom (#EC30F8) every burst; a small white-hot bolt.
quickref.impact_end_result: Magenta-pink flashes (#D534EE) on the struck target. No status effect.

quickref.status: Named on the 2026 Steam page [Canon]. Held at 1/1 in the 2.54.0 tutorial (Jul 9, 2026); second weapon in a PT4 loadout (HUD icon).
quickref.look: Coral-red hexagonal tube (#AF5860 in dim light) with glowing orange-gold chevron panels (#CF7F3A-#FCA74C), a grey checker band at the flared muzzle, and a bolted round rear plate. Held under the arm. About 0.7x Oliver. NOT green or hazard-striped.
quickref.firing_and_projectile: 1 rocket, 1.5 s, 2.5 s reload, 1,000 u/s (wiki). Steam trailer rocket 1.92-3.05 s (2013 footage [Inference, strong]): white launch burst with an orange core; grey stepped hex nose, glowing yellow/orange checker panels, maroon tail with pink-red lights, spiky orange-yellow flame shards, white puff trail; it leaves the frame without detonating [Observed; Bearzooka link Inference, high]. Unseen in 2026 frames; the 2026 red checker-band rocket with white smoke is Tillman's.
quickref.impact_end_result: Explosives 40-60, AoE 125/250, easy to kill yourself (wiki). Blasts credited to it appear only in low-res 2014-15 fan footage: a faceted yellow polygon blast with grey or dark-grey smoke [Observed, per oliver.addendum.md; Bearzooka link Inference, high]; the Steam trailer shows none. Unattributed 2026 explosions are pale-yellow translucent faceted blasts (#FAFFB0); using that style for the 2026 Bearzooka is an inference.

quickref.look: Blue bolt (#478CD2) with a white rim on a dark-maroon hexagonal prism (#3F2523); the same design as the Joules currency icon.
quickref.impact_end_result: Lie or float where players died. They are not Kill Confirmed tags: they also appear in non-KC matches, and the KC feed uses a separate tag-shaped icon [Inference]. That they are Joule drops is [Inference, likely].

It can stack with the yellow-and-black Irradiated disc; that pair is the 2026 'trefoil with a Z' [Observed].
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Not applicable; it appears when a slowing item connects [Fan-wiki].
quickref.impact_end_result: The victim is slowed ('dozing off while moving'), or rooted for 2.5 s by the Phantom Hug while still able to attack; it shows even when cloaked [Fan-wiki].

quickref.status: BBR v1.3.2 (2012); shown in official SkyVu shorts dated Jun 25 and Jul 2, 2026 (build Unverified)
quickref.look: Near-black keypad box (≈ #2A2D28) with lit blue-teal keys on the back of the right hand, a looping black cable, a grey octagonal cuff and a pale glowing hand, about 0.3× Oliver [Observed]. A cosmetic charge crackle is green-white on Jun 25 and magenta-white (≈ #D909ED) on Jul 2 [Observed].
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Spawns a huge faceted orb, about 1.5–2× bear height [Inference]: a near-white translucent shell (#E8F8F8 to #F8F8F8) around a bright cyan core (#38F8F8 to #78F8F8), NOT dark blue [Observed]. It is harmless for 2 s, then accelerates; up to three orbs [Fan-wiki]. White-blue arcs zap nearby enemies [Observed].
quickref.impact_end_result: Implodes on contact: 40–60 damage plus 30 on a direct hit, AoE 50/150, high self-kill risk [Fan-wiki]. No 2026 implosion frame exists [Unverified].

quickref.status: Launch default (2013); in SkyVu's 'Stormtrooper Aim' short, Jun 20, 2026 (identity by shape)
quickref.look: Right forearm in an orange octagonal collar, then a white-and-orange riveted cylinder with a black octagonal muzzle; about 0.6× Oliver [Observed; ID Inference]. Armour is dusty rose-maroon (#90585E to #A36A71) [Observed].
quickref.firing_and_projectile: A small orange-yellow flash bursts on a wall beside an unharmed target, matching the 'Stormtrooper Aim' joke [Observed; attribution Inference]. The round itself is not visible [Unverified].

quickref.status: 2013 launch; in SkyVu's 'Stormtrooper Aim' short, Jun 20, 2026
quickref.look: Back unit of riveted white plates over orange plates with round holes, plus two black thrusters with glowing orange ends [Observed; ID Inference].
quickref.firing_and_projectile: A broad translucent pale-yellow light column (#F8F898 to #F8F8B8, orange base #F8B868) blasts up from the back unit beside the target. It is not a muzzle flash [Observed].
quickref.impact_end_result: Next frame: the target's backpack, an armour chunk and a blue Joule bolt lie on the floor [Observed]; a kill [Inference].

quickref.status: Steam-trailer footage (7.25–10.5 s; 2013 footage [Inference, strong]: the same shots are in the May 2013 trailer's storyboard) reused by SkyVu on Mar 4, 2026
